d: We are looking for an experienced PMO Manager with a strong background in the IT industry to establish, lead, and continuously improve the Project Management Office (PMO). The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing project governance, ensuring consistent project management practices, monitoring project performance, and aligning project delivery with the organization's strategic objectives.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
8–12 years of experience in project management, PMO, or program management within the IT industry.
At least 3–5 years of experience in a PMO leadership or managerial position.
Strong experience managing multiple IT projects and large-scale project portfolios.
Solid understanding of IT project lifecycles, software development, infrastructure, digital transformation, and enterprise technology projects.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid approaches.
Experience in project governance, portfolio management, resource planning, budgeting, and risk management.
Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making skills.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to develop and interpret project performance metrics and KPIs.
Hands-on experience with project management tools such as Jira, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
